subject.title: feat(worktrees): configurable cleanup limits (max count, max total size) with Settings UI

question: Should OpenClaw permanently add `worktrees.cleanup.maxCount` and `worktrees.cleanup.maxTotalSizeGb` as core configuration and Control UI settings?
rationale: These persistent retention-policy controls expand OpenClaw's already-large configuration surface, so implementation correctness alone cannot decide whether the product should support this permanent contract.

options.title: Approve core limits
options.body: Keep the opt-in core configuration and UI after reload behavior and real-Gateway proof are complete.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Retain bounded cleanup while exposing a smaller permanent policy surface, such as one consolidated retention control.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Keep the existing time-based cleanup behavior and close the linked feature direction.

recommendation.title: Approve core limits
recommendation.body: Keep the opt-in core configuration and UI after reload behavior and real-Gateway proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only concrete feature-history candidate visible in the supplied context, though independent merged-history routing was unavailable.
